source.title: Ghana Standard Treatment Guidelines
source.publisher: Ministry of Health, Ghana / Ghana National Drugs Programme
source.note: Clinical decision support reference. Rules should be checked against current facility policy and newer national guidance.

rules.condition: Diagnosis contains malaria and no MPS/blood film or malaria RDT appears among investigations
exceptions: Suspected severe malaria where testing is not immediately possible
Children under five where the 2017 STG describes a clinical exception
rules.review: Check the laboratory register and clinical notes before treating as an error.

rules.condition: Systemic antibiotic present but no obvious bacterial diagnosis
rules.review: Compare diagnosis, indication, route and STG treatment guidance. Do not add a diagnosis just to justify a prescription.

rules.condition: H. pylori diagnosis or H. pylori eradication regimen without a related test listed
rules.review: Check for a test in the lab record; not every dyspepsia patient requires testing.

rules.condition: Iron-deficiency diagnosis without FBC/CBC or Hb in listed investigations
rules.review: Check records for results and assess the complete clinical context.

rules.condition: Typhoid/enteric fever diagnosis without related investigation listed
rules.review: Verify evidence; Widal alone should not be treated as definitive confirmation.

rules.condition: UTI diagnosis without urine investigation listed
rules.review: Verify investigations and whether testing was indicated.

icd10.policy: Suggest a lookup when code is missing. A clinician/claims reviewer must confirm the match and store the confirmed code in the diagnosis catalogue; never guess from free text.
